# Midnight Invoice

> Invoice generator with an agent API. AI agents can connect to a user's
> workspace (after the user approves them) and create, read, update and
> delete invoices, read default sender settings and download PDFs.

## Connect an agent (device flow, no browser login needed)

1. POST /api/v1/agents/register with {"name", "description"?, "scopes": [...]}
   Scopes: invoices:read, invoices:write, invoices:delete, settings:read
2. Show the user `user_code` and `verification_url_complete`; they approve it in the app.
3. Poll POST /api/v1/agents/token with {"device_code"} every `interval` seconds
   until it returns {"api_key"} (errors: authorization_pending, slow_down,
   access_denied, expired_token). The key is shown once.
4. Send `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` on every request.

## Docs

- [OpenAPI 3.1](/api/v1/openapi.json): full REST contract
- [MCP endpoint](/api/mcp): remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP, stateless, POST, same Bearer key)
- Agent guide: AGENT_API.md in the source repository (https://github.com/0xzapata/midnight-invoice/blob/main/AGENT_API.md)
